field.$description: Shared hooks for form fields: TextField, TextArea, Select, and other labeled inputs.

gap.$description: Vertical gap between a field's label, input, and description/error rows.

height.$description: Height of single-line field inputs (TextField, Select trigger).

padding-y.$description: Vertical padding inside multi-line field inputs (TextArea). Single-line inputs center content within field.height instead.

surface-disabled.$description: Background of disabled field inputs (canonical disabled recipe).

text.$description: Entered-value text color inside field inputs.

text-disabled.$description: Text color inside disabled field inputs (canonical disabled recipe); AA-checked against field.surface-disabled via the muted-on-sunken pair.

placeholder.$description: Placeholder text color inside field inputs.

focus.$description: Input border when focused; combine with shadow.focus-ring.

disabled.$description: Input border when the field is disabled (canonical disabled recipe).
